title: Dependency Audit Exceptions
description: High/critical vulnerabilities that are accepted for a limited time with documented compensating controls. Every entry must include owner, rationale, compensating_control, ISO 8601 expiry, and review_trigger. Only GHSA advisories are accepted; unmatched advisories always fail closed.

exceptions.rationale: Transitive via mammoth@^0.8.6 (used only for .docx resume text extraction); @xmldom/xmldom is not imported directly anywhere in app/api/src. The advisories are fixed only in 0.9.x, which is outside mammoth's ^0.8.6 range, so no non-breaking upgrade exists yet without bumping/forking mammoth.
exceptions.compensating_control: Candidate .docx parsing runs inside the bounded, fail-closed sandboxed resume-parser child (binary stdin, no network egress) behind a ClamAV signature-freshness scan, with size/MIME gating before the bytes ever reach mammoth/@xmldom. No untrusted XML reaches @xmldom outside that sandbox, and a parse failure fails closed.
exceptions.review_trigger: A mammoth release depending on @xmldom/xmldom>=0.9.0 (or a verified npm override) becomes available; re-run the audit and remove these entries.
